title: ZKnowledgeCompounding P0 深挖：存储与生命周期载体
summary: 针对 P0 三项（T1.1 数据模型载体 / T1.2 生命周期与衰减建模 / T1.3 本地优先 vs 服务端）评估 5 个存储候选：Kuzu、pgvector(+Postgres)、Electric、Automerge、TerminusDB。结论：MVP 采用 Postgres+pgvector 并在 schema 自建双时态与衰减；图遍历先用递归 CTE；保持仓储层可替换以平滑切到 Kuzu 或 TerminusDB；同步/多端延后。所有候选均无原生衰减语义，衰减必须在应用层建模。XTDB 因编译器无法解析 submodule 树被排除，需带外验证。

concepts.value: Choose the storage and lifecycle substrate for ZKC (T1.1 data-model carrier, T1.2 lifecycle/decay modeling, T1.3 local-first vs server) under personal-data, offline-capable, low-dependency constraints.
Coverage scored native / adapted / absent / unknown per topic; an unobserved capability is reported as unknown, never as absent.
Store choice is a swappable infrastructure seam; ZKC owns the dual-track schema, the temporal/validity model, and the decay semantics regardless of substrate.
problem-discovery / selection phase for the ZKC storage substrate; findings are point-in-time and pre-MVP.

cards.title: Kuzu — embedded property graph with vector search
cards.summary: Embedded (serverless) property-graph database, Cypher, native vector index + full-text search, columnar disk storage, WASM bindings for in-browser execution, MIT licensed. Strongest fit where graph traversal and vector search must live in one local process; no temporal/versioning model.

cards.title: pgvector — vector search inside Postgres
cards.summary: Postgres extension giving embeddings, metadata, joins, ACID and PITR in one local/self-hosted store; HNSW/IVFFlat indexes. Hard limit: ANN index caps at 2,000 dims (float) / 4,000 (halfvec). No graph traversal or temporal model of its own — those must be built in schema (recursive CTE / adjacency, valid_from/valid_to).

cards.title: Electric — Postgres partial replication for local-first clients
cards.summary: Syncs filtered Postgres 'shapes' to clients over HTTP with cursor resume, enabling local-first/offline reads; writes round-trip through the server. Sync engine is 1.x stable, but adds a self-hosted Elixir service + Postgres dependency. Its new Agents platform is churning.

cards.title: Automerge — CRDT document store for offline-first
cards.summary: CRDT library (JSON-like docs, Rust core → WASM/JS/C) with compression format and sync protocol, aimed at local-first apps. Gives conflict-free offline merge and history, but is a document/event store, not a graph or vector store — query and retrieval must be built on top.

cards.title: TerminusDB — knowledge graph with git-like version control
cards.summary: Document/knowledge-graph database (JSON-LD) with commits per update, JSON diff/patch, push/pull/clone, and time-travel queries at any commit; WOQL Datalog, v12 temporal interval reasoning, 12.1-rc vector search. Closest to ZKC's lifecycle/versioning need, but is a server deployment, not embedded.

claims.text: pgvector adds vector similarity search to Postgres as an extension: vector / halfvec / bit / sparsevec types, L2 / cosine / inner-product / L1 / Hamming / Jaccard distances, and HNSW or IVFFlat indexes, keeping embeddings, metadata and joins in one transactional store with PITR.

pgvector caps ANN indexing at 2,000 dimensions for single-precision vector (4,000 for halfvec), so a 3,072-dimension embedding model cannot be HNSW-indexed as float and must use halfvec, binary quantization, or dimensionality reduction; filtered ANN search additionally requires iterative-scan tuning.

Kuzu is an embedded property-graph database implementing Cypher with a native vector index and full-text search, columnar disk storage, and WASM bindings enabling in-browser / in-memory execution, i.e. no separate server process.

Electric replicates filtered Postgres 'shapes' to clients over HTTP with cursor-based resume (handle + offset) and is packaged as a self-hosted Elixir sync service plus Postgres, as evidenced by its docker-compose deployment; client writes go through the server and flow back.
Electric's sync engine is 1.x stable, while its 2026 'Electric Agents' platform is newly introduced and fast-changing with breaking renames, so agent-facing surfaces carry churn risk.

Automerge is a CRDT library with a JSON-like document model (Rust core exposed to JavaScript via WASM and to C via FFI) plus a compression format and sync protocol, explicitly positioned as 'PostgreSQL for your local-first app'.

TerminusDB ships as a Docker-deployed server (evidenced by its Dockerfiles) and is documented as a knowledge-graph database with git-like version control, per-commit time-travel queries, JSON diff/patch, and WOQL Datalog, with temporal interval reasoning added in v12.

No sealed candidate provides native knowledge decay or TTL semantics; inspection of the vector and graph candidates found retention only as storage-level concerns (e.g. replay buffers), so ZKC's decay model must live in the application schema.

comparisons.text: T1.1 数据模型载体的三类路线：(a) 嵌入式图库 Kuzu —— 图遍历 + 向量 + 全文在一个进程内，无服务依赖，但关系/时态能力弱；(b) Postgres + pgvector —— 关系 + 向量 + 事务 + PITR 一体，最成熟，图与时态需在 schema 自建；(c) 版本化知识图 TerminusDB —— 原生 commit/时间旅行/JSON diff，但为服务端部署。对 ZKC MVP，(b) 的依赖最少、可本地运行、且与上一份报告结论（Utopia 用 Postgres+pgvector+双时态）一致。

T1.2 生命周期与衰减：只有 TerminusDB 提供原生 commit/时间旅行版本控制（git-like），最接近 ZKC 需要的「事实随时间演进」；pgvector/Postgres 需自建 valid_from/valid_to + 事务时间的双时态 schema；Kuzu 与 Electric 无任何时态模型。而**衰减(decay)语义在所有 5 个候选中都缺失** —— 存储层只提供保留/回放等存储级生命周期，不提供知识腐化模型。结论：ZKC 的双时态可在 Postgres 上自建，衰减必须在应用层建模。

T1.3 本地优先 vs 服务端：Kuzu 与 Automerge 是真正的嵌入式/离线优先（库形态，无服务进程）；Postgres+pgvector 可完全本地自托管但需要一个数据库实例；Electric 与 TerminusDB 引入服务进程。ZKC 的约束是个人数据 + 隐私 + 离线可用，因此 MVP 应优先「单进程/少依赖」形态。注意：sealed ledger 未能验证任一候选的 local_first_offline（见信息缺口），该结论需动手验证。
衰减是共性缺口：所有候选都没有 TTL/知识腐化语义（C8）。这意味着 ZKC 不能把「动态信息会腐化」这一核心语义外包给存储 —— 必须在 schema 中显式建模 decay 分数 + 计划重评估，并由调度层驱动。这与上一份报告的发现一致（稀缺注意力调度无人覆盖，需自建）。
同步/多端（Electric 的 shape 复制、Automerge 的 CRDT 合并）能力成熟，但对 ZKC MVP 属于**非必要复杂度**：MVP 是单人单机场景。Electric 还会引入 Elixir 服务 + Postgres 的额外依赖，且其 Agents 平台正在破坏性变更（C5）。建议延后到多端成为真实需求时再评估。

recommendations.text: MVP 存储载体选 **Postgres + pgvector**（本地/自托管，单依赖），并在 schema 层自建双时态（valid_from/valid_to + 事务时间）与 decay 分数；图遍历先用递归 CTE/邻接表，不引入图数据库。理由：依赖最少、可离线运行、事务与 PITR 成熟、且与上一份报告中 Utopia（Postgres+pgvector+双时态+人审蒸馏）验证过的形态一致。同时**保持仓储层接口可替换**（repository seam），使后续可平滑切到 Kuzu（若图遍历成为核心）或 TerminusDB（若需要原生版本控制/时间旅行）。

动手验证清单（在承诺架构前）：(1) 离线捕获 spike —— 在断网/无服务进程条件下验证 Postgres+pgvector 与 Kuzu 的可用性，补齐 ledger 未验证的 local_first_offline；(2) 衰减模型 spike —— 用 50 条动态条目验证 decay 分数 + 计划重评估是否真的能防止腐化；(3) 带外验证 XTDB —— 它是最强的双时态候选，但被 pinned 编译器因 submodule 树解析失败而排除，需另行 inspect 后再决定是否替换时态层。

riskRegister.risk: No sealed candidate provides knowledge decay or TTL, so ZKC's decay model must live in the application schema.
riskRegister.trigger: Assuming the chosen store will manage knowledge decay.
riskRegister.impact: Dynamic survival-type information rots silently and compounding value is lost.
riskRegister.mitigation: Model decay explicitly as a score plus scheduled re-evaluation in the ZKC schema, independent of storage, and validate it with a decay spike over 50 dynamic items.
riskRegister.residualRisk: Decay logic can drift from storage semantics if it is not re-baselined per release.

riskRegister.risk: The sealed ledger could not verify local-first/offline capability for any of the five candidates; those assessments rest on documentation inspection only.
riskRegister.trigger: Committing to a local-first substrate without a hands-on offline test.
riskRegister.impact: The chosen store may still require a running server, breaking offline capture of dynamic info.
riskRegister.mitigation: Run an offline-capture spike (no network, no server) against the shortlisted store before MVP commitment.
riskRegister.residualRisk: Offline behavior may still differ on the actual target device.

riskRegister.risk: XTDB, the strongest bitemporal candidate, was excluded because the pinned research compiler cannot parse its submodule tree.
riskRegister.trigger: Treating these five as the complete option space for temporal modeling.
riskRegister.impact: A superior temporal substrate may be overlooked for the lifecycle layer.
riskRegister.mitigation: Validate XTDB out-of-band by direct inspection, and keep the temporal layer swappable behind a repository interface so it can be adopted later.
riskRegister.residualRisk: XTDB remains unverified in this report.

riskRegister.risk: pgvector's ANN index cap (2,000 dims for float vector) can silently break a 3,072-dimension embedding model choice.
riskRegister.trigger: Selecting a large embedding model without checking the index dimension cap.
riskRegister.impact: No ANN index can be created; semantic retrieval degrades to sequential scan.
riskRegister.mitigation: Pin the embedding model to at most 2,000 dimensions or use halfvec / binary quantization, and assert index creation in CI.
riskRegister.residualRisk: A future model upgrade can reintroduce the cap.

riskRegister.risk: Electric's Agents platform is newly introduced and has already had breaking renames.
riskRegister.trigger: Building ZKC's agent integration on Electric Agents.
riskRegister.impact: Rework when the agent API changes.
riskRegister.mitigation: Use Electric only for its stable 1.x sync layer if sync is ever needed, and keep the Agents surface out of the MVP.
riskRegister.residualRisk: Even the sync layer API may evolve.

informationGaps.rationale: Has information gaps: the sealed ledger left 8 criteria unknown, including local_first_offline for all five candidates and decay_lifecycle for kuzu and terminusdb; these assessments rest on documentation inspection and require hands-on validation. Additionally XTDB (the strongest bitemporal candidate) could not be sealed because the pinned compiler cannot parse its submodule tree, so the temporal option space is not fully verified.
